_comment: Lead capture settings. Forms post to the HubSpot Forms API (no HubSpot script needed). Paste each form's GUID from HubSpot > Marketing > Forms > (form) > Share > Embed code ('formId'). Until a GUID is set, that form validates but cannot send, and qa.py prints a WARN.

topbar._comment: The top-bar event from the design. After 'ends' it is replaced by the fallback link, at build time and again in the visitor's browser.
